en: Black‑and‑white view of a wide unpaved street in a European town, lined with two‑ and three‑storey buildings. On the left is a large inn with a sign reading "Gasthof zur Krone" (Inn at the Crown). People stand in front of the inn and along the street; a few carts are visible on the right. In the background are more houses and a church tower with a baroque spire rising above trees. Wooden fences, telegraph poles, and early‑20th‑century clothing suggest a small town scene from that era.
